page.overview:
Who is Customer?

The Customer is found at the counter of Kakariko Village's Milk Bar. If talked to, he will snap at Link for bothering him, but then apologizes immediately afterward, stating that he did not mean to be rude.

He goes on to explain that he was simply thinking about using a magnifying glass for reading maps. However, he also says that his eyesight is now so bad, not even a magnifying glass can aid him.

If talked to again, he will give the young hero a tip about using the zoom-in and zoom-out buttons on the map.
